s6m_featherless_saturation.description: S_C: Featherless (P50=312ms, P99=497ms, C=1 HARD limit, 50%+ 429 rate at c>=2). S_A: Parasail OpenRouter (P50=500ms, $0.15/$1.20 per M). Burst workload drives S_C saturation.
s6m_featherless_saturation.name: s6m_featherless_saturation

s7m_quota_depletion.description: S_Q: Ollama (P50=305ms, quota=100 scaled for depletion). S_A: Parasail_OR (P50=500ms, $0.15/$1.20 per M). Joint alpha=0 should stay on Ollama; psi(z) triggers smooth handoff to S_A as quota depletes.
s7m_quota_depletion.name: s7m_quota_depletion

s8m_multi_sq_hierarchy.description: Three S_Q providers with different latency/quota. Ollama (P50=305ms, quota=50), Chutes_S_Q (P50=976ms, quota=100), MiniMax_S_Q (P50=1715ms, quota=50). S_A fallback: Parasail_OR ($0.15/$1.20 per M). Joint should prefer Ollama first.
s8m_multi_sq_hierarchy.name: s8m_multi_sq_hierarchy
